entries.title: Psalms 91:1
segments: ¶He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

entries.title: Psalms 91:2
segments: I say of Jehovah, My refuge and my fortress; my God, I will confide in him.

entries.title: Psalms 91:3
segments: Surely *he* shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, [and] from the destructive pestilence.

entries.title: Psalms 91:4
segments: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou find refuge: his truth is a shield and buckler.

entries.title: Psalms 91:5
segments: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, for the arrow that flieth by day,

entries.title: Psalms 91:6
segments: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 91:7
segments: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; [but] it shall not come nigh thee.

entries.title: Psalms 91:8
segments: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, and see the reward of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 91:9
segments: ¶Because *thou* hast made Jehovah, my refuge, the Most High, thy dwelling-place,

entries.title: Psalms 91:10
segments: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

entries.title: Psalms 91:11
segments: For he shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to keep thee in all thy ways:

entries.title: Psalms 91:12
segments: They shall bear thee up in [their] hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

entries.title: Psalms 91:13
segments: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and the adder; the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under foot.

entries.title: Psalms 91:14
segments: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

entries.title: Psalms 91:15
segments: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honour him.

entries.title: Psalms 91:16
segments: With length of days will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
